info.title: role.proto
info.description:
Role Service provides CRUD operations for managing roles within groups.
A Role is a named subset of permissions drawn from its parent Group.

Roles are the primary mechanism for granting access to Subjects.
A Subject can be assigned multiple Roles, and their effective permissions
are the union of all assigned Roles' permissions.

Key constraint: A Role's permissions must always be a subset of
its parent Group's permissions (the Subset Constraint). This is
enforced at the service implementation layer.

get.summary:
ListRoles returns a paginated list of roles.
Can optionally filter by group_uid.

parameters.name: groupUid
parameters.description:
group_uid optionally filters roles to a specific group.
If empty, returns all roles across all groups.

parameters.name: pagination.limit
parameters.description: The number of items per page

parameters.name: pagination.orderBy
parameters.description: what field to use for ordering

post.summary: CreateRole creates a new role within a group.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CreateRoleRequest contains the fields needed to create a new role.

get.summary: ListRolePermissions returns all permissions assigned to a role.

parameters.name: roleUid
parameters.description: role_uid identifies which role's permissions to list.

parameters.name: pagination.limit
parameters.description: The number of items per page

parameters.name: pagination.orderBy
parameters.description: what field to use for ordering

post.summary: AssignRolePermission adds a permission to a role.

parameters.name: roleUid
parameters.description: role_uid identifies which role to receive the permission.

delete.summary: RevokeRolePermission removes a permission from a role.

parameters.name: roleUid
parameters.description: role_uid identifies which role to modify.

parameters.name: permissionUid
parameters.description: permission_uid identifies which permission to revoke.

get.summary: GetRole retrieves a role by its public UID.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid is the public unique identifier of the role.

delete.summary:
DeleteRole permanently removes a role by its UID.
This will cascade to remove all subject assignments for this role.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid identifies which role to delete.

put.summary: UpdateRole modifies an existing role's details.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: uid identifies which role to update.

permissionUid.description: permission_uid identifies which permission to assign.

RoleServiceAssignRolePermissionBody.description: AssignRolePermissionRequest adds a permission to a role.

name.description: name is the new name for the role.

RoleServiceUpdateRoleBody.description: UpdateRoleRequest contains fields to update an existing role.

uid.description:
uid is the public unique identifier for this permission.
This UUID is used in API requests and remains stable across
database migrations or internal ID changes.

resource.description:
resource identifies the domain entity this permission applies to.
Examples: "invoices", "users", "settings", "reports"
Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores.

action.title:
action specifies the operation allowed on the resource.
Common values: "read", "write", "delete", "admin"

description.description:
description provides a human-readable explanation of this permission's
scope and purpose, useful for admin UI display and audit logs.

createdAt.description: created_at is the Unix timestamp (seconds) when this permission was created.

updatedAt.description: updated_at is the Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last modification.

permissionPermission.description:
Permission represents a granular access control unit.
It defines what action can be performed on a specific resource.

success.description: success indicates the assignment was successful.

message.description: message provides an optional confirmation message.

assignedAt.description: assigned_at is the Unix timestamp when the permission was assigned.

groupUid.description:
group_uid identifies the parent group for this role.
The group must exist before creating a role within it.

name.description:
name is the human-readable name of the role.
Must be unique within the parent group.

roleCreateRoleRequest.description: CreateRoleRequest contains the fields needed to create a new role.

role.description: role is the newly created role with its assigned UID.

meta.description: meta contains optional metadata about the operation.

success.description: success indicates the deletion was successful.

message.description: message provides an optional human-readable confirmation.

deletedAt.description: deleted_at is the Unix timestamp when the role was deleted.

permissions.description: permissions is the list of permissions assigned to this role.

roles.description: roles is the list of roles for the current page.

roleListRolesResponse.description: ListRolesResponse returns a paginated list of roles.

success.description: success indicates the revocation was successful.

message.description: message provides an optional confirmation message.

revokedAt.description: revoked_at is the Unix timestamp when the permission was revoked.

updatedAt.description: updated_at is the Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last modification.

Role represents a named subset of permissions within a group.
Roles are assigned to Subjects to grant access.
